name: Order Attire
description: Please order your attire by this date. This allows time to take advantage of Black Friday deals. Last year, Birdy Grey offered up to 75% off, and Men's Wearhouse offered up to 70% off. Ordering early also gives plenty of time for shipping, exchanges, and alterations.

name: Exchanges & Accessories
description: By this date, you should have received and tried on your attire. Start any exchanges or replacements needed as soon as possible.Purchase any remaining accessories, such as shoes, jewelry, ties, socks, or other items needed to complete your outfit.

name: Alterations
description: Begin any necessary alterations. Please do not wait until the last minute, as seamstress availability can become limited during wedding season.

name: Full Outfit Try-On
description: Alterations should be complete. Try on your full outfit, including shoes and accessories, to make sure everything fits comfortably and is ready for the wedding day.
